theorem etcdstart.ascii_append {s t : GoString} (hs : asciiStr s) (ht : asciiStr t) : asciiStr (s ++
    t)

theorem etcdstart.membersOf_set (pfx : GoString) (pb cb : w64) (j k : Nat) (hj : j < k) (z :
    etcdstart.GMember) : (etcdstart.membersOf pfx j pb cb ++ List.replicate (k - j) z).set j
    (etcdstart.memberAt pfx pb cb (W64 ↑j)) = etcdstart.membersOf pfx (j + 1) pb cb ++
    List.replicate (k - (j + 1)) z

theorem etcdstart.membersOf_succ (pfx : GoString) (k : Nat) (pb cb : w64) : etcdstart.membersOf pfx
    (k + 1) pb cb = etcdstart.membersOf pfx k pb cb ++ [etcdstart.memberAt pfx pb cb (W64 ↑k)]

theorem etcdstart.membersOf_length (pfx : GoString) (k : Nat) (pb cb : w64) : (etcdstart.membersOf
    pfx k pb cb).length = k

structure etcdstart.MemberG.{u_1} (GF : BundledGFunctors) : Type (max 1 u_1) where
  id : w64
  γ : SrvRaft
  ρ : ReqNames
  E : apply.AEnv GF

theorem etcdstart.membersOf_getElem (pfx : GoString) (k : Nat) (pb cb : w64) (i : Nat) (h : i < k) :
    (etcdstart.membersOf pfx k pb cb)[i]? = some (etcdstart.memberAt pfx pb cb (W64 ↑i))

theorem etcdstart.drop_cons_of_getElem?.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (l : List α) (n : Nat) (x : α) (h :
    l[n]? = some x) : List.drop n l = x :: List.drop (n + 1) l

def etcdstart.memberAt (pfx : GoString) (pb cb i : w64) : etcdstart.GMember :=
  { Name' := pfx ++ go!"-" ++ decStr i,
    Peer' := go!"127.0.0.1:" ++ decStr (pb + i),
    Client' := go!"127.0.0.1:" ++ decStr (cb + i) }

theorem etcdstart.memberAt_name_utf8 (pfx : GoString) (hp : asciiStr pfx) (pb cb i : w64) :
    utf8Valid (etcdstart.memberAt pfx pb cb i).Name'

theorem etcdstart.not_mem_decStr (c : w8) (hc : BitVec.toNat c < 48 ∨ 57 < BitVec.toNat c) (p : w64)
    : ¬c ∈ decStr p

theorem etcdstart.bytesSplit_noSep (c : w8) (s : List w8) (h : ¬c ∈ s) : bytesSplit c s = [s]

theorem etcdstart.name_not_mem_take (ms : List etcdstart.GMember) (hnd : (List.map (fun x =>
    x.Name') ms).Nodup) (j : Nat) (m : etcdstart.GMember) (h : ms[j]? = some m) : ¬m.Name' ∈
    List.map (fun x => x.Name') (List.take j ms)

theorem bytesSplit.eq_def (c : w8) (x✝ : List w8) : bytesSplit c x✝ = match x✝ with | [] => [[]] | b
    :: bs => match bytesSplit c bs with | [] => [[b]] | p :: ps => if b = c then [] :: p :: ps else
    (b :: p) :: ps

theorem etcdstart.decNumeral_decStr (p : w64) (hp : 0 < BitVec.toNat p) : decNumeral? (decStr p) =
    some (BitVec.toNat p)

theorem etcdstart.decStr_length_le (p : w64) : List.length (decStr p) ≤ 65

theorem etcdstart.decStr_digits (p : w64) (c : w8) : c ∈ decStr p → 48 ≤ BitVec.toNat c ∧
    BitVec.toNat c ≤ 57

def etcdstart.urlsN (ms : List etcdstart.GMember) (m : etcdstart.GMember) (U : BootURLs) : Prop :=
  U.peer = [etcdstart.httpURL m.Peer'] ∧
    U.client = [etcdstart.httpURL m.Client'] ∧
      (∀ (n : GoString), (U.initMap !! n).isSome = true ↔ n ∈ List.map (fun x => x.Name') ms) ∧
        U.initURLs = etcdstart.iuOf ms

theorem etcdstart.set_replicate_snoc.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (l : List α) (n : Nat) (z a : α) (h :
    l.length < n) : (l ++ List.replicate (n - l.length) z).set l.length a = l ++ [a] ++
    List.replicate (n - (l.length + 1)) z

def etcdstart.GMember : Type :=
  github_com.mit_pdos.etcd_grove.examples.lib.etcdstart.Member

def etcdstart.iuOf (ms : List etcdstart.GMember) (n : GoString) : List net.url.URL :=
  match List.find? (fun m => decide (m.Name' = n)) ms with
  | some m => [etcdstart.httpURL m.Peer']
  | none => []

theorem etcdstart.loopback_ne (p q : w64) (h : p ≠ q) : go!"127.0.0.1:" ++ decStr p ≠
    go!"127.0.0.1:" ++ decStr q

theorem etcdstart.membersOf_names_nodup (pfx : GoString) (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ 2 ^ 64) (pb cb : w64) :
    (List.map (fun x => x.Name') (etcdstart.membersOf pfx k pb cb)).Nodup

theorem etcdstart.memberUp_tok [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (s : Loc) (ρ : ReqNames) (E₀ :
    apply.AEnv GF) (lg : Loc) (γn : NetNames GF) (id : w64) (m : lease.Mode) : etcdstart.memberUp s
    ρ E₀ lg γn id m ⊢ threadTok ∗ (threadTok -∗ etcdstart.memberUp s ρ E₀ lg γn id m)

def etcdstart.membersOf (pfx : GoString) (k : Nat) (pb cb : w64) : List etcdstart.GMember :=
  List.map (fun i => etcdstart.memberAt pfx pb cb (W64 ↑i)) (List.range k)

theorem etcdstart.baseDigits_head_ne0 (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) : ∃ d ds, baseDigits 10 ⋯ n = d :: ds ∧
    d ≠ 0

theorem etcdstart.foldl_digits (ds : List Nat) (hd : ∀ (d : Nat), d ∈ ds → d < 10) (a : Nat) :
    List.foldl (fun acc c => acc.bind fun n => if 48 ≤ BitVec.toNat c ∧ BitVec.toNat c ≤ 57 then
    some (10 * n + (BitVec.toNat c - 48)) else none) (some a) (List.map digitChar ds) = some
    (List.foldl (fun a d => 10 * a + d) a ds)

theorem etcdstart.decStr_ascii (p : w64) : asciiStr (decStr p)

def etcdstart.memberPre (N : Nat) (token : GoString) (ms : List etcdstart.GMember) (ps : List w64)
    (bootLog : List EntryM) (ctxs : List (List w8)) (dir : w64 → List GoString) (Φs : w64 → w64 →
    List w8 → GName → IProp GF) (γn : NetNames GF) (lm : lease.Mode) (x : etcdstart.GMember ×
    etcdstart.MemberG GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(etcdstart.bootPremise N ps bootLog ctxs dir token x.fst.Name' (etcdstart.urlsN ms x.fst) x.snd.id ∗
      etcdstart.memberBoot x.snd.γ ctxs x.snd.ρ x.snd.E Φs x.snd.id false lm ∗
        netHttpOk γn x.snd.id ∗ etcdstart.memberFreshRes x.fst.Name' { peer := some x.fst.Peer' } γn)

theorem etcdstart.iuOf_mem (ms : List etcdstart.GMember) (hnd : (List.map (fun x => x.Name')
    ms).Nodup) (m : etcdstart.GMember) (hm : m ∈ ms) : etcdstart.iuOf ms m.Name' =
    [etcdstart.httpURL m.Peer']

theorem etcdstart.take_succ_names (ms : List etcdstart.GMember) (j : Nat) (m : etcdstart.GMember) (h
    : ms[j]? = some m) (n : GoString) : n ∈ List.map (fun x => x.Name') (List.take (j + 1) ms) ↔ n ∈
    List.map (fun x => x.Name') (List.take j ms) ∨ n = m.Name'

theorem etcdstart.digitChar_digit (d : Nat) (hd : d < 10) : 48 ≤ BitVec.toNat (digitChar d) ∧
    BitVec.toNat (digitChar d) ≤ 57 ∧ BitVec.toNat (digitChar d) - 48 = d

theorem etcdstart.memberAt_name_len (pfx : GoString) (hp : List.length pfx ≤ 134) (pb cb i : w64) :
    List.length (etcdstart.memberAt pfx pb cb i).Name' ≤ 200

theorem etcdstart.netAddrLit_loopback (p : w64) (h1 : 1 ≤ BitVec.toNat p) (h2 : BitVec.toNat p ≤
    65535) : netAddrLit (go!"127.0.0.1:" ++ decStr p) = true
